title: Rolling window / hits
description: How many recent hits each point of the mean and UR traces averages. Smaller reacts faster but is noisier. Clamped to 10–500.

title: Chart height / px
description: Height of the chart area; the panel grows with it. Clamped to 128–220 px.

title: Show UR trace
description: Adds a second lane with the rolling unstable rate under the mean trace.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag in the panel header.
